Tokyo: Senso-ji Temple, Asakusa — Tokyo's oldest temple, iconic Kaminarimon gate
Shibuya Crossing — the famous scramble crossing, best viewed from a nearby cafe
teamLab Planets / Borderless — immersive digital art museum
Tsukiji Outer Market — street food and fresh seafood
Meiji Shrine — forested shrine near Harajuku, calm contrast to the city
Paris: Eiffel Tower — go at sunset for the best light
Louvre Museum — book timed entry in advance to skip lines
Montmartre & Sacré-Cœur — artists' quarter with panoramic views
Seine River Cruise — good low-effort overview of major landmarks
Le Marais — historic district, great for food and boutique shopping
Singapore: Gardens by the Bay — Supertree Grove light show at night
Marina Bay Sands SkyPark — rooftop infinity pool view (non-guests can visit the observation deck)
Hawker centres (e.g. Maxwell Food Centre) — best budget-friendly local food
Sentosa Island — beaches and family attractions
Chinatown & Little India — walkable cultural districts
